tips.title: 批判推理 (Critical Reasoning) 核心五大題型模型
tips.body:
GMAT 批判推理是商學院入學測驗的靈魂，考查嚴密邏輯思維：
1. 假設題 (Assumption)：找尋作者推導結論時「未言明但必不可少的必要條件」。檢驗法：否定測試法 (Negation Technique)——否定選項後，檢查前提對結論的必要支持是否斷裂，不需證明結論本身為假。
2. 削弱題 (Weaken)：找出一個新資訊，能證明「即使前提成立，結論也未必成立」（常考因果倒置、另有他因、樣本偏差）。
3. 支持題 (Strengthen)：排除潛在他因、證實無因即無果、強化樣本代表性。
4. 推論題 (Inference)：100% 依據題幹已知事實推導，嚴禁任何無端腦補。
5. 評價題 (Evaluate)：找出若回答 Yes 或 No 會分別強烈支持或削弱結論的關鍵變數。
tips.example: 現行 GMAT 規則：徹底排除舊版文法改錯 (Sentence Correction)；完成全卷 23 題後，若有剩餘時間，可以檢查本節作答，但至多修改 3 道題答案！

tips.title: 題型一・CR Weaken & Strengthen 因果論證三大致命漏洞與攻防向量 (Causal Argument Vulnerabilities)
tips.body:
【核心構念 (Construct Essence)】
因果推論是 GMAT CR 可練習的一類論證（Premise: 事件 A 發生，Conclusion: A 導致 B）。商學院評估候選人是否能敏銳識別商業決策中的歸因謬誤。

【步驟 0 破題思維 (Step 0 Mindset)】
1. 區分事實與推論：題幹中給定的 Premise 為不可爭辯的既成事實，絕不可質疑 Premise 本身之真實性，攻擊點永遠在 Premise 到 Conclusion 的推導邏輯漏洞！
2. 識別三大漏洞：
   - 另有他因 (Alternative Cause)：忽視可能同時存在的外部變量 C 才是造成 B 的真因。
   - 因果倒置 (Reverse Causality)：將結果與原因順序搞反。
   - 樣本選擇偏差 (Selection Bias)：由特殊自願群體推論全體母體。
3. 削弱與加強的對偶性：
   - 削弱題：主動引入另有他因、因果倒置可能、或指出樣本偏差。
   - 加強題：主動排除混淆變量、證實「無 A 則無 B」、或提供平行行業類似操作的成功驗證。

【致命陷阱診斷 (Traps Diagnosis)】
• 陷阱 1：質疑前提事實。選項若企圖反駁題幹已給出的統計數據，直接排除！
• 陷阱 2：無關信息混淆。涉及產品外包裝顏色、公司成立歷史等無關商業細節，皆為經典干擾項。

【大師經典示範題精析 (Master Worked Demonstration)】
題目：某連鎖超市延長每晚營業時間 2 小時後，該季度銷售額增長了 15%。經理因此宣稱，延長營業時間是銷售增長的原因。問哪項最削弱？
大師解剖：另有他因攻擊！正確選項：該季度該超市同時啟動了全店 7 折會員促銷活動。促銷提供替代解釋，削弱把增長全歸因於營業時間的推論，但不能據此斷定營業時間完全沒有影響。
tips.example: 因果攻防金律：削弱找「他因/倒置/偏差」；加強找「排他因/無因無果/同因同果」！

tips.title: 題型二・CR Assumption 假設題「否定測試法」決策樹 (Negation Decision Tree)
tips.body:
【核心構念 (Construct Essence)】
假設（Assumption）是讓論證結論得以成立的「未明言必要條件 (Sine Qua Non)」。沒有這個假設，作者的推理大廈將瞬間坍塌。

【步驟 0 破題思維 (Step 0 Mindset)】
否定測試法 (Negation Technique) 三步 SOP：
1. 步驟一：選取待測選項，否定整個命題而不改變範圍（all 的否定是 not all；some 的否定是 none），不能只機械增刪 NOT。
2. 步驟二：將取非後的命題帶回原題幹，檢視原論證結論是否受到實質致命衝擊。
3. 步驟三：若否定後，前提對結論的必要支持連結斷裂，該選項符合必要假設；不需要證明結論本身為假。

【致命陷阱診斷 (Traps Diagnosis)】
• 陷阱 1：充分條件陷阱。假設必須是「必要條件」，不可將題目推向過度嚴苛的充分條件（例如：結論只需降低成本，選項不需保證降低所有產品的成本）。
• 陷阱 2：極端絕對語氣。遇到 all, completely, impossible 等詞須檢查範圍，但不可只靠語氣排除；必要性取決於該題的論證。

【大師經典示範題精析 (Master Worked Demonstration)】
題目條件：每台車的其他成本不變，機器人的新增成本只有維護與折舊。結論：節省人工後，每台車的生產總成本會下降。
假設檢驗：
選項：每台車分攤的機器人維護與折舊成本小於節省的人工工資。
取非測試：若每台車新增成本「大於或等於」省下的工資，在其他成本不變的條件下，總成本就不會下降。注意「小於」的否定包含相等；缺少其他成本不變的條件時，不能只靠這一項保證總成本方向。
tips.example: 否定測試口訣：「取非即死」——選項取反若能一劍封喉擊潰作者結論，該選項必為作者心底默認的底層假設！

tips.title: 題型三・CR Method of Reasoning / Boldface 黑體字角色題判定決策樹 (Boldface Role Architecture)
tips.body:
【核心構念 (Construct Essence)】
黑體字題考查對學術與商業論證內部各組件功能角色的抽象結構認知。考生必須抽離具體商業細節，精確識別各句的邏輯功能。

【步驟 0 破題思維 (Step 0 Mindset)】
1. 判定組件屬性 (Fact vs. Claim)：
   - 客觀事實 (Evidence / Premise / Finding / Data)：歷史數據、實驗測量結果、既成事實。
   - 主觀主張 (Claim / Judgment / Hypothesis / Position)：作者或反對派提出的判斷、預測或結論。
2. 判定立場陣營 (Support vs. Oppose)：
   - 該黑體字是站在作者立場，還是站在作者反對的立場（Opponent's argument）？
3. 判定結論層級：
   - 是中間過渡結論 (Intermediate / Subsidiary Conclusion)，還是全篇最終推論 (Main Conclusion)？
4. 排除技巧：快速掃描選項前半句與後半句的功能關鍵字，只要一處不符合立即排除，無需全文細讀選項。

【致命陷阱診斷 (Traps Diagnosis)】
• 陷阱 1：混淆中間結論與最終結論。中間結論後方往往還有 However 或 Therefore 引導全篇最終立場。
• 陷阱 2：立場張冠李戴。將作者用來駁斥的對手前提誤當成作者自己的支持論據。

【大師經典示範題精析 (Master Worked Demonstration)】
句型結構：[Many analysts claim that company X will dominate the EV sector.] (BF 1) However, because rare earth raw material costs have doubled, [this projection is largely overoptimistic.] (BF 2)
大師解剖：BF 1 是作者反對的主張 (a claim that the argument seeks to challenge)；BF 2 是作者提出的最終主要結論 (the main conclusion of the argument)。直接在選項中精準匹配！
tips.example: 黑體字定位關鍵詞：However, But, Clearly, Therefore, Hence 往往是立場轉換與最終結論的旗幟標誌。

tips.title: 題型四・商學長文精讀與 Data Insights 跨文本邏輯 (Two-Sided Platforms & Multi-Source Synthesis)
tips.body:
GMAT 閱讀篇幅長、句法密集，涉及企業管理戰略、雙邊平台網路效應、金融市場、科技演進、反壟斷監管：
- 略讀框架：每段只精讀第一句與轉折句，在草稿紙寫下段落功能（P1: 提出舊商業理論；P2: 實證數據挑戰舊理論；P3: 提出新平台經濟模型）。
- Data Insights 語言整合：比對圖表趨勢與多來源文本陳述，找出邏輯矛盾與數據盲區。
- 雙邊平台動態 (Two-Sided Platforms)：跨邊網路外部性 (Cross-Side Network Effects) 與補貼策略。
tips.example: 商業決策題常見陷阱：將「相關性 (Correlation)」誤當成「因果性 (Causation)」，或將「利潤增加」誤當成「銷售額增加」（忽略成本變量）。

phrases.example: The financial projection was formulated on the assumption that interest rates remain stable.
Operational inefficiencies account for a substantial fraction of production losses.
Successful venture trials paved the way for a multibillion-dollar initial public offering.
Regulatory complacency can lead to severe systemic market vulnerabilities.

dialogue.speaker: Mentor
dialogue.en: The client expects a price cut to increase both market share and profit.
dialogue.zh: 客戶預期降價能同時提高市占率和利潤。

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.en: What would have to be true for profit to rise?
dialogue.zh: 要讓利潤增加，需要哪些條件成立？

dialogue.speaker: Mentor
dialogue.en: Extra sales would need to make up for the lower margin and any added costs.
dialogue.zh: 新增銷售必須彌補較低利潤率和增加的成本。

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.en: We should also ask how competitors might respond before accepting that forecast.
dialogue.zh: 接受預測前，也應詢問競爭對手可能如何回應。

extra.title: 論證假設：找出理由與結論之間的缺口
extra.rule: 證據是作者提供的理由，結論是作者要你接受的主張。必要假設是論證成立所依賴、卻未說明的條件。GMAT 與 GRE 相關閱讀練習可運用這個方法；題目問必要假設或加強論證時，判準不同。運用取非檢驗法：否定該選項後，若前提不再足以支持原本推論，便找到了必要連結；這不表示結論本身必定為假。否定量詞時也要小心：all 的否定是 not all，而不是 none。
pairs: A bus service proposes adding trips because current buses are crowded. It predicts the extra trips will reduce crowding.
證據：現有班次擁擠。結論：新增班次能減少擁擠。
The extra trips can serve at least some of the passengers who currently crowd the buses.
必要的連結：新增服務要能承接原本擁擠的需求。
Every passenger prefers buses to trains.
過強且非必要：即使有人偏好火車，增加適當班次仍可能減少擁擠。
extra.trap: 加強選項可能只讓結論更可信，卻不是缺它不可。另勿把「否定某選項」誤作「把結論反過來」。區分必要假設與非必要加強項。
extra.model: 條件：員工能有效使用新軟體，而且主要工作瓶頸能被它改善。反例：軟體操作訓練耗時，或真正瓶頸是等待客戶回覆。避免只以「軟體很新」推論必定更快。

c-intl-gmat.tip1.title: 批判推理 (Critical Reasoning) 核心五大題型模型
c-intl-gmat.tip1.body: GMAT 批判推理是商學院入學測驗的靈魂，考查嚴密邏輯思維： 1. 假設題 (Assumption)：找尋作者推導結論時「未言明但必不可少的必要條件」。檢驗法：否定測試法 (Negation Technique)——否定選項後，檢查前提對結論的必要支持是否斷裂，不需證明結論本身為假。 2. 削弱題 (Weaken)：找出一個新資訊，能證明「即使前提成立，結論也未必成立」（常考因果倒置、另有他因、樣本偏差）。 3. 支持題 (Strengthen)：排除潛在他因、證實無因即無果、強化樣本代表性。 4. 推論題 (Inference)：100% 依據題幹已知事實推導，嚴禁任何無端腦補。 5. 評…
c-intl-gmat.tip1.example: 現行 GMAT 規則：徹底排除舊版文法改錯 (Sentence Correction)；完成全卷 23 題後，若有剩餘時間，可以檢查本節作答，但至多修改 3 道題答案！

c-intl-gmat.tip2.title: 題型一・CR Weaken & Strengthen 因果論證三大致命漏洞與攻防向量 (Causal Argument Vulnerabilities)
c-intl-gmat.tip2.body: 【核心構念 (Construct Essence)】 因果推論是 GMAT CR 可練習的一類論證（Premise: 事件 A 發生，Conclusion: A 導致 B）。商學院評估候選人是否能敏銳識別商業決策中的歸因謬誤。 【步驟 0 破題思維 (Step 0 Mindset)】 1. 區分事實與推論：題幹中給定的 Premise 為不可爭辯的既成事實，絕不可質疑 Premise 本身之真實性，攻擊點永遠在 Premise 到 Conclusion 的推導邏輯漏洞！ 2. 識別三大漏洞： - 另有他因 (Alternative Cause)：忽視可能同時存在的外部變量 C 才是造成 B …
c-intl-gmat.tip2.example: 因果攻防金律：削弱找「他因/倒置/偏差」；加強找「排他因/無因無果/同因同果」！

c-intl-gmat.tip3.title: 題型二・CR Assumption 假設題「否定測試法」決策樹 (Negation Decision Tree)
c-intl-gmat.tip3.body: 【核心構念 (Construct Essence)】 假設（Assumption）是讓論證結論得以成立的「未明言必要條件 (Sine Qua Non)」。沒有這個假設，作者的推理大廈將瞬間坍塌。 【步驟 0 破題思維 (Step 0 Mindset)】 否定測試法 (Negation Technique) 三步 SOP： 1. 步驟一：選取待測選項，否定整個命題而不改變範圍（all 的否定是 not all；some 的否定是 none），不能只機械增刪 NOT。 2. 步驟二：將取非後的命題帶回原題幹，檢視原論證結論是否受到實質致命衝擊。 3. 步驟三：若否定後，前提對結論的必要支持連結斷…
c-intl-gmat.tip3.example: 否定測試口訣：「取非即死」——選項取反若能一劍封喉擊潰作者結論，該選項必為作者心底默認的底層假設！

c-intl-gmat.tip4.title: 題型三・CR Method of Reasoning / Boldface 黑體字角色題判定決策樹 (Boldface Role Architecture)
c-intl-gmat.tip4.body: 【核心構念 (Construct Essence)】 黑體字題考查對學術與商業論證內部各組件功能角色的抽象結構認知。考生必須抽離具體商業細節，精確識別各句的邏輯功能。 【步驟 0 破題思維 (Step 0 Mindset)】 1. 判定組件屬性 (Fact vs. Claim)： - 客觀事實 (Evidence / Premise / Finding / Data)：歷史數據、實驗測量結果、既成事實。 - 主觀主張 (Claim / Judgment / Hypothesis / Position)：作者或反對派提出的判斷、預測或結論。 2. 判定立場陣營 (Support vs. Opp…
c-intl-gmat.tip4.example: 黑體字定位關鍵詞：However, But, Clearly, Therefore, Hence 往往是立場轉換與最終結論的旗幟標誌。

c-intl-gmat.tip5.title: 題型四・商學長文精讀與 Data Insights 跨文本邏輯 (Two-Sided Platforms & Multi-Source Synthesis)
c-intl-gmat.tip5.body: GMAT 閱讀篇幅長、句法密集，涉及企業管理戰略、雙邊平台網路效應、金融市場、科技演進、反壟斷監管： - 略讀框架：每段只精讀第一句與轉折句，在草稿紙寫下段落功能（P1: 提出舊商業理論；P2: 實證數據挑戰舊理論；P3: 提出新平台經濟模型）。 - Data Insights 語言整合：比對圖表趨勢與多來源文本陳述，找出邏輯矛盾與數據盲區。 - 雙邊平台動態 (Two-Sided Platforms)：跨邊網路外部性 (Cross-Side Network Effects) 與補貼策略。
c-intl-gmat.tip5.example: 商業決策題常見陷阱：將「相關性 (Correlation)」誤當成「因果性 (Causation)」，或將「利潤增加」誤當成「銷售額增加」（忽略成本變量）。

k.argument-assumptions.tip.title: 論證假設：找出理由與結論之間的缺口
k.argument-assumptions.tip.formula: 辨認結論、證據與必要假設，熟練取非檢驗法，評估批判邏輯嚴密性。
k.argument-assumptions.tip.body: 證據是作者提供的理由，結論是作者要你接受的主張。必要假設是論證成立所依賴、卻未說明的條件。GMAT 與 GRE 相關閱讀練習可運用這個方法；題目問必要假設或加強論證時，判準不同。運用取非檢驗法：否定該選項後，若前提不再足以支持原本推論，便找到了必要連結；這不表示結論本身必定為假。否定量詞時也要小心：all 的否定是 not all，而不是 none。
k.argument-assumptions.tip.example: A bus service proposes adding trips because current buses are crowded. It predicts the extra trips will reduce crowding. / The extra trips can serve at least some of the passengers who currently crowd the buses.

k.argument-assumptions.1.prompt: Which most weakens the bus prediction?
options: The extra trips run only when the buses are already almost empty.
The buses are blue.
Some riders carry backpacks.
k.argument-assumptions.1.answer: The extra trips run only when the buses are already almost empty.
k.argument-assumptions.1.why: 非擁擠時段增班無法回應原來的問題，直接攻擊證據與結論連結。車色與背包沒有提供相關反證。

d.diag-1751.prompt: A municipal transit agency introduced express bus lanes on major arteries and observed a twenty percent increase in ridership over six months. The director concluded that dedicating lanes exclusively to buses directly caused commuters to abandon private automobiles. Which of the following is an assumption required by the director's argument?
options: Private automobile registrations in the municipality decreased by exactly twenty percent over the six months.
Bus fares were doubled immediately following the installation of the dedicated express lanes.
The surge in bus ridership was not primarily driven by an influx of new residents or fuel price spikes occurring during the same period.
The express bus routes experienced zero mechanical breakdowns throughout the evaluation period.
d.diag-1751.answer: The surge in bus ridership was not primarily driven by an influx of new residents or fuel price spikes occurring during the same period.
d.diag-1751.hint: 這題考：Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
d.diag-1751.why: GMAT 核心題型：排除外生因果混雜變數 (Alternative Causes)。 正確答案為「The surge in bus ridership was not primarily driven by an influx of new residents or fuel price spikes occurring during the same period.」。GMAT 核心題型：排除外生因果混雜變數 (Alternative Causes)。 此項精準鎖定核心邏輯因果關係，其餘干擾選項若非偏離討論範疇 (Out of Scope)，即為混淆充分與必要條件、或反向削弱/支持。

d.diag-1752.prompt: A retail chain eliminated paper coupons and shifted its entire promotional budget to smartphone app notifications, subsequently recording record quarterly sales. The marketing VP asserted that app notifications are far more effective at stimulating consumer purchases than print media. Which assumption underlies this conclusion?
options: The retailer's competitor declared bankruptcy during the same quarter.
Smartphone ownership among the retailer's customers reached one hundred percent.
Print coupons cost twice as much to distribute as digital notifications.
Customers who made purchases through the app would not have spent an equal or greater amount had print coupons been retained alongside the app.
d.diag-1752.answer: Customers who made purchases through the app would not have spent an equal or greater amount had print coupons been retained alongside the app.
d.diag-1752.hint: 這題考：Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
d.diag-1752.why: 否定檢驗法 (Negation Test)：若紙本帶來更多消費，則結論被擊潰。 正確答案為「Customers who made purchases through the app would not have spent an equal or greater amount had print coupons been retained alongside the app.」。否定檢驗法 (Negation Test)：若紙本帶來更多消費，則結論被擊潰。 此項精準鎖定核心邏輯因果關係，其餘干擾選項若非偏離討論範疇 (Out of Scope)，即為混淆充分與必要條件、或反向削弱/支持。

d.diag-1753.prompt: A manufacturing corporation installed ergonomic chairs and standing desks across its headquarters and subsequently observed a fifteen percent drop in employee absenteeism. Management concluded that ergonomic furniture directly improved employee physical health, thereby reducing sick leave. Which assumption is required?
options: The decline in absenteeism was not primarily attributable to a newly implemented remote-work policy enacted at the same time.
Every employee used the standing function of their desk for at least four hours daily.
The cost of the ergonomic furniture was completely offset by productivity gains within six months.
Absenteeism rates in competing firms increased over the same chronological timeframe.
d.diag-1753.answer: The decline in absenteeism was not primarily attributable to a newly implemented remote-work policy enacted at the same time.
d.diag-1753.hint: 這題考：Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
d.diag-1753.why: 因果歸因必要假設：排除同時發生的重大干擾政策。 正確答案為「The decline in absenteeism was not primarily attributable to a newly implemented remote-work policy enacted at the same time.」。因果歸因必要假設：排除同時發生的重大干擾政策。 此項精準鎖定核心邏輯因果關係，其餘干擾選項若非偏離討論範疇 (Out of Scope)，即為混淆充分與必要條件、或反向削弱/支持。

d.diag-1754.prompt: A regional hospital mandated that all surgeons complete a ten-minute mindfulness meditation prior to entering the operating theater, resulting in a thirty percent reduction in postoperative surgical complications. The chief of surgery concluded that surgeon meditation directly enhances surgical precision. Which assumption is necessary?
options: Surgeons who meditated slept an average of two hours longer each night.
The complexity and risk profile of the surgical procedures performed remained comparable before and after the mindfulness mandate.
Postoperative complications were entirely eradicated following the introduction of the policy.
Patients were informed of their surgeon's meditation practice prior to anesthesia.
d.diag-1754.answer: The complexity and risk profile of the surgical procedures performed remained comparable before and after the mindfulness mandate.
d.diag-1754.hint: 這題考：Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
d.diag-1754.why: 控制變數假設：手術難度維持相當 (comparable complexity)。 正確答案為「The complexity and risk profile of the surgical procedures performed remained comparable before and after the mindfulness mandate.」。控制變數假設：手術難度維持相當 (comparable complexity)。 此項精準鎖定核心邏輯因果關係，其餘干擾選項若非偏離討論範疇 (Out of Scope)，即為混淆充分與必要條件、或反向削弱/支持。

d.diag-1755.prompt: An airline replaced hot meal service with pre-packaged snack boxes on short-haul flights and saw customer satisfaction scores increase by eight points. The executive concluded that passengers prefer light snacks over elaborate hot meals. What does this argument assume?
options: Snack boxes cost the airline forty percent less to provision than hot catering.
Every passenger on short-haul flights consumed the entirety of their snack box.
The increase in satisfaction scores was not caused by significant improvements in flight punctuality during the trial.
Hot meals will be permanently discontinued across all transcontinental international routes.
d.diag-1755.answer: The increase in satisfaction scores was not caused by significant improvements in flight punctuality during the trial.
d.diag-1755.hint: 這題考：Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
d.diag-1755.why: 排除他因假設：滿意度上升並非由準點率改善所致。 正確答案為「The increase in satisfaction scores was not caused by significant improvements in flight punctuality during the trial.」。排除他因假設：滿意度上升並非由準點率改善所致。 此項精準鎖定核心邏輯因果關係，其餘干擾選項若非偏離討論範疇 (Out of Scope)，即為混淆充分與必要條件、或反向削弱/支持。

d.diag-1756.prompt: A tech enterprise switched from annual performance evaluations to continuous weekly feedback sessions, observing a twenty-five percent increase in software deployment frequency. Leadership inferred that continuous feedback directly accelerated developer output. Which assumption is required?
options: Annual reviews caused severe psychological distress among all engineering staff.
Developers worked forty percent more overtime hours following the policy change.
Software bug density doubled as a consequence of faster deployments.
The increased deployment frequency was not the result of breaking software updates into smaller, more frequent increments.
d.diag-1756.answer: The increased deployment frequency was not the result of breaking software updates into smaller, more frequent increments.
d.diag-1756.hint: 這題考：Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
d.diag-1756.why: 排除測量口徑改變之他因：非因拆小更新所致。 正確答案為「The increased deployment frequency was not the result of breaking software updates into smaller, more frequent increments.」。排除測量口徑改變之他因：非因拆小更新所致。 此項精準鎖定核心邏輯因果關係，其餘干擾選項若非偏離討論範疇 (Out of Scope)，即為混淆充分與必要條件、或反向削弱/支持。
